listings.title: Car Flipping Profit Tracker Spreadsheet UK, Used Car Trader Stock & Profit Log, Excel & Google Sheets, Days in Stock, Tax Year Summary
listings.description:
Know exactly what every car really made you.
This tracker is for people who buy, fix and sell cars, vans or bikes in the UK, whether it is a side hustle or a small trade.
WHAT IT DOES
- Vehicles sheet: purchase price, buyer's fees, sale price, selling fees, net profit, ROI and days in stock for every vehicle.
- Cost Log: log parts, labour, MOT, valeting, transport and adverts against each vehicle; totals flow in automatically.
- Dashboard: total profit, average profit per car, average days to sell, money tied up in unsold stock, loss-making sales, best and worst deals, month-by-month results.
- Deal Analyser: enter comparable adverts, expected costs, auction fees and your target profit to get your maximum bid before you buy.
- Profit by where you bought (auction, private, trade, part-ex) and where you sold.
- UK tax year summary (6 April to 5 April) with a flag when takings pass £1,000.
WHAT YOU GET
- Blank tracker (.xlsx) and an example copy with sample vehicles so you can see how it works.
- Works in Microsoft Excel and free Google Sheets. No macros, no subscription.
GOOD TO KNOW
- This is a record-keeping tool, not tax or legal advice. It does not calculate VAT or the margin scheme.
- Digital download: nothing is posted. Instant download after purchase.

listings.title: UK Reseller Profit Tracker Spreadsheet, eBay Vinted Depop Sales Log, HMRC Platform Reporting 30 Sales Check, Excel & Google Sheets
listings.description:
See your real profit on every item, and how close you are to the point where UK platforms report sellers to HMRC.
WHAT IT DOES
- Sales sheet: cost, sale price, postage charged and paid, platform fees, net profit, margin and days to sell for every item.
- Platform Check: per platform and calendar year, your sales count and value against the reporting thresholds (30 sales or about £1,700). Warns you when you get close.
- Tax Year: takings and profit by UK tax year, with your own personal items kept separate.
- Dashboard: profit, margin, stock at cost, items losing money, and results by platform and category.
- Settings: thresholds you can update if the rules change.
WHAT YOU GET
- Blank tracker (.xlsx) and an example copy with sample items.
- Works in Microsoft Excel and free Google Sheets. No macros, no subscription.
GOOD TO KNOW
- Being reported by a platform is not a tax bill, and HMRC says reporting is not a new tax. This is a record-keeping tool, not tax advice.
- Digital download: instant download after purchase.
